facts.fact: StackAdapt published its 'New video campaign: Speed that makes the difference' blog post on June 16, 2021.

StackAdapt describes itself as an AI-powered advertising and orchestration platform that unifies programmatic and owned channels, including CTV, DOOH, display, native, audio, email, and more, into a single platform.
facts.quote: StackAdapt is the AI-powered advertising and orchestration platform that unifies programmatic and owned channels—including CTV, DOOH, display, native, audio, email, and more—into a single platform

facts.fact: In June 2021, StackAdapt launched a brand awareness video campaign, created with an external party, that focuses on the speed of its platform.
facts.quote: With the help of an external party, we created a brand new video to illustrate what makes StackAdapt unique.

facts.fact: StackAdapt updated its logo around the time it launched its 2021 brand awareness campaign.
facts.quote: As we prepared to launch this brand awareness campaign, we felt it was the perfect time to update our logo.
